title: Onukrom — sales & distribution app for Bangladesh
metaDescription: Orders, deliveries, collections and stock for distributors in Bangladesh: an Android app for your field team and a panel for your office.
announce: New: guided setup and bKash / Nagad billing — try it free for 14 days
headline: Your field team and office, on one screen
subline: Sales reps take orders on the app, delivery men deliver and collect, and the office sees every taka and every carton live.

shots.dashboard: Today’s sales, collections and dues at a glance
shots.orders: Orders from the app, ready to approve

rolesTitle: One system for everyone in your business

panel.title: Run the whole day from one panel
panel.text: Orders arrive from the field the moment they are taken. Approve, send out, and collect — no phone calls, no paper.

approve.title: Approve in seconds
approve.text: See the shop, the items, the GPS check and the credit limit before you say yes.

deliver.title: Plan every trip
deliver.text: Load approved orders onto a delivery man’s trip and follow it live.

collect.title: Count every taka
collect.text: Cash, bKash, Nagad and bank — collected, deposited and confirmed.

field.title: Everything your field team does, in their pocket
field.text: Big buttons, Bangla first, made for the market — not the office.

order.title: Take an order in a minute
order.text: Cartons and pieces, the right price for each shop.

shops.title: Find or add the shop
shops.text: Nearest shops first; new shops with GPS.

trip.title: Deliver and collect
trip.text: Delivered, partial or failed — and the cash taken.

offline.title: No network? No problem
offline.text: Saved on the phone, sent when you pull to refresh.

home.title: The day at a glance
home.text: Today’s orders, sales and deliveries left.

charts.title: Charts that answer questions
charts.text: Sales trend, sales by sales rep and route, collections by method.

pdf.title: PDF and Excel in one click
pdf.text: Print the whole report or any list — Bangla prints correctly.

dues.title: Dues by age
dues.text: Which shops owe, and for how long since their last order.

grid.title: Everything a distributor needs
grid.text: No add-ons, no extra apps. Every plan has every feature.

collections.title: Collections & deposits
collections.text: Confirm payments and the cash your staff hand in.

deliveries.title: Trips & deliveries
deliveries.text: Who carries what, and what came back.

stock.title: Stock in every store
stock.text: Godown, vans and damage store; low-stock alerts.

pricing.title: Price lists
pricing.text: Wholesale, pharmacy or area prices, with history.

areas.title: Areas & routes
areas.text: Visit days and who covers each route.

staff.title: Staff & roles
staff.text: Invite by phone number; decide who may do what.

gps.title: Every order checked against the shop’s location
gps.text: Orders far from the shop, fake GPS or a weak signal are flagged for the office — so you can trust what comes in.

control.title: Built for owners who want control

roles.title: Roles & permissions
roles.text: Owner, manager, sales rep, delivery man — or your own roles.

device.title: One phone per staff
device.text: Sign a lost phone out from the office.

gps.title: GPS on every order
gps.text: Location checks the office can see.

offline.title: Offline first
offline.text: Work keeps going when the network does not.

company.title: Create your company
company.text: Log in to the panel. A guide shows each step.

setup.title: Add routes, products, staff
setup.text: Invite sales reps and delivery men by phone number.

orders.title: Take orders
orders.text: Your team installs the app and starts the same day.

pricing.title: Simple monthly prices
pricing.text: Every plan has every feature. 14 days free, then pay by bKash, Nagad or bank.

trial.a: Yes — 14 days with everything included. Your first invoice appears a week before the trial ends.

internet.q: What if there is no internet in the market?
internet.a: The app keeps orders, deliveries and payments on the phone and sends them when the network is back. Pull down on the screen to send them right away.

phones.q: Which phones does the app work on?
phones.a: Android phones. The office uses the panel in any browser — computer or phone.

pay.a: By bKash, Nagad, Rocket or bank transfer. Enter the transaction ID on the Billing page and we confirm it.

data.q: Is my data separate from other companies?
data.a: Yes. Every company only ever sees its own shops, orders, prices and staff.

help.a: A guide inside the panel shows every step, and you can ask our team from Help & support in Bangla or English.

final.title: Start taking orders this week
final.text: Set up your company today; your team can take orders from the app tomorrow.

footer.about: Sales and distribution software for Bangladesh.
